column2: A Pradeshiya Sabha shall disclose the following:

(i) 
the accounting policies adopted in measuring inventories, including the method used;

(ii) 
the total carrying amount of inventories and the carrying amount in classifications appropriate

(iii) 
the amount of inventories recognized as an expense during the period;

(iv) 
write off within the period or  inventories or reversions recognized as losses; and

(v) 
the total carrying amount of inventories pledged as security for liabilities
